paper.title: Worst-Case Optimal Multi-Armed Gaussian Best Arm Identification with a Fixed Budget

settings.name_in_paper: Fixed-budget BAI in the Gaussian bandit model P^G(a*, Delta_low, Delta_bar) with known variances
unmapped: Every suboptimal arm's gap lies in a known interval [Delta_low, Delta_bar] with 0 < Delta_low <= Delta_bar < infinity
Arm-dependent (heteroscedastic across arms) but known Gaussian variances, bounded in [C_low, C_bar] (unknown constants)
Performance measured by the asymptotic exponent -1/T log P(misidentification), worst case over means and the identity of the best arm
settings.definition_quote: This study focuses on an instance $P\in\mathcal{P}$ where $(Y^1, Y^2, \dots, Y^K)$ follows a multivariate Gaussian distribution with a unique best arm ... $\forall a\in[K]\backslash\{a^*\}\ \underline{\Delta} \leq \mu^{a^*} - \mu^a \leq \overline{\Delta}$ ... The decision-maker knows the true values of the variances $((\sigma^a)^2)_{a\in[K]}$ but does not know $a^*$ and $(\mu^a)_{a\in[K]}$.

algorithms.name: GNA-EBA strategy (Generalized Neyman Allocation with Empirical Best Arm recommendation)

symbols.Delta_bar: upper bound on the gaps mu^{a*} - mu^a
symbols.G_star: max_{w in simplex} min_{a*, a != a*} 1/(2*Omega^{a*,a}(w)), with Omega^{a*,a}(w) = sigma_{a*}^2/w(a*) + sigma_a^2/w(a)

conditions: strategy is consistent and asymptotically invariant (pi in Pi^cons ∩ Pi^inv)
worst case (infimum) over all P in union over a* of P^G(a*, Delta_low, Delta_bar)

source.label: thm:semipara_bandit_lower_bound_lsmodel_asymp_inv_equiv2
source.quote: For any $0 < \underline{\Delta} \leq \overline{\Delta} < \infty$, any consistent (Definition~\ref{def:consistent}) strategy $\pi\in\Pi^{\mathrm{cons}}\cap \Pi^{\mathrm{inv}}$ satisfies $\inf_{P\in\cup_{a^*\in[K]}\mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{G}}(a^*, \underline{\Delta}, \overline{\Delta})}\limsup_{T \to \infty} -\frac{1}{T}\log \mathbb{P}_{P}( \widehat{a}^\pi_T \neq a^*)\leq \mathrm{LowerBound}(\overline{\Delta}) \coloneqq \max_{w\in\mathcal{W}}\min_{a^*\in[K]}\frac{\overline{\Delta}^2}{2\Omega^{a^*, a}(w)}$

results.notes: Bound is on the exponent -1/T log P(error); encoded as P_err >~ exp(-T*rate). The statement says 'any consistent strategy' but writes Pi^cons ∩ Pi^inv; the text (Sec 5.6) claims the invariance restriction is removable. Recorded with both restrictions as written.

symbols.Delta_low: lower bound on the gaps mu^{a*} - mu^a
symbols.Omega_GNA: max_{a != a*} Omega^{a*,a}(w^GNA) = sigma_{a*}^2/w^GNA(a*) + sigma_a^2/w^GNA(a) (the proof takes min over a != a* of the rate)

conditions: P_0 in P^G(a*, Delta_low, Delta_bar) for some a*
tuning: w^GNA = argmax_w min_{a*, a != a*} 1/(2 Omega^{a*,a}(w)) computed from known variances

source.label: thm:upper_pom
source.quote: For any $0 < \underline{\Delta} \leq \overline{\Delta} < \infty$, any $a^*\in[K]$, and any $P_0\in\mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{G}}(a^*, \underline{\Delta}, \overline{\Delta})$, the GNA-EBA strategy satisfies \[\liminf_{T \to \infty} - \frac{1}{T}\log \mathbb{P}_{P_0}\left(\widehat{a}^{\mathrm{EBA}}_T \neq a^*\right)\geq \frac{\underline{\Delta}^2}{2\Omega^{a^*, a}(w^{\mathrm{GNA}})}.\]

results.notes: Exponent lower bound encoded as P_err <~ exp(-T*rate). Index a is free in the statement; proof yields min over a != a*. Allocation is non-adaptive.

symbols.G_star: max_{w in simplex} min_{a*, a != a*} 1/(2*Omega^{a*,a}(w))

conditions: worst case over P in union over a* of P^G(a*, Delta_low, Delta_bar)

source.label: cor:asymp_opt
source.quote: For any $0 < \underline{\Delta} \leq \overline{\Delta} < \infty$, the GNA-EBA strategy satisfies $\inf_{P\in\cup_{a^*\in[K]}\mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{G}}(a^*, \underline{\Delta}, \overline{\Delta})}\liminf_{T \to \infty} - \frac{1}{T}\log \mathbb{P}_{P}\left(\widehat{a}^{\mathrm{EBA}}_T \neq a^*\right)\geq \mathrm{UpperBound}(\underline{\Delta}) \coloneqq \min_{a^*\in[K]}\frac{\underline{\Delta}^2}{2\Omega^{a^*, a}(w^{\mathrm{GNA}})} = \max_{w\in\mathcal{W}}\min_{a^*\in[K]}\frac{\underline{\Delta}^2}{2\Omega^{a^*, a}(w)}$.

results.notes: Matches the lower bound of Theorem 4.1 when Delta_low = Delta_bar (Theorem 4.4, Corollary 4.5).

symbols.G_star: max_{w in simplex} min_{a*, a != a*} 1/(2*Omega^{a*,a}(w))

conditions: all suboptimal gaps equal to Delta (Delta_low = Delta_bar = Delta)
worst case over the identity of the best arm and the means

source.quote: Additionally, for any $0< \Delta < \infty$ and for $\overline{\mathcal{P}}^{\mathrm{G}}(\Delta) \coloneqq \Big\{P \in \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{G}}(a^*, \underline{\Delta}, \overline{\Delta})\mid a^*\in [K],\ \ \underline{\Delta} = \overline{\Delta} = \Delta\Big\}$, we have $\sup_{\pi \in \Pi^{\mathrm{cons}}}\inf_{P \in\overline{\mathcal{P}}^{\mathrm{G}}(\Delta)}\liminf_{T \to \infty} - \frac{1}{T}\log \mathbb{P}_{P}(...)\leq \max_{w\in\mathcal{W}}\min_{a^*\in[K]}\frac{\Delta^2}{2\Omega^{a^*, a}(w)} = ... \leq \inf_{P}\liminf ... (GNA-EBA)

results.notes: Theorem also shows the GNA-EBA achieves this rate (special case of Theorem 4.3 with Delta_low = Delta_bar), and that LowerBound - UpperBound -> 0 as the gap interval shrinks. Corollary 4.5 restates this matching. The derivation relies on Theorem 4.1, which is stated for Pi^cons ∩ Pi^inv; the claim for all consistent strategies rests on the argument of Section 5.6.

symbols.R_P0: sup_{w in simplex} min_{a != a*} Delta_a^2 / (2*(sigma_{a*}^2/w(a*) + sigma_a^2/w(a)))

conditions: strategy is consistent and asymptotically invariant (pi in Pi^cons ∩ Pi^inv)

source.label: thm:global
source.quote: For any $0 < \underline{\Delta} \leq \overline{\Delta} < \infty$, any $a^*\in[K]$, and any $P_0 \in \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{G}}(a^*, \underline{\Delta}, \overline{\Delta})$, any consistent ... and asymptotically invariant ... strategy $\pi\in\Pi^{\mathrm{cons}}\cap \Pi^{\mathrm{inv}}$ satisfies $\limsup_{T \to \infty} - \frac{1}{T}\log \mathbb{P}_{P_0}(\widehat{a}^\pi_T \neq a^*)\leq\sup_{w\in\mathcal{W}} \min_{a\in[K]\backslash\{a^*\}}\frac{\left(\Delta^a(P_0)\right)^2}{2\Omega^{a^*, a}(w)}$.

results.notes: Per-instance exponent upper bound (i.e. error-probability lower bound).

symbols.sigma_star: standard deviation of the best arm a*

conditions: strategy is consistent and asymptotically invariant (pi in Pi^cons ∩ Pi^inv)

source.label: thm:semipara_bandit_lower_bound_lsmodel_asymp_inv
source.quote: For any $0 < \underline{\Delta} \leq \overline{\Delta} < \infty$, any $a^*\in[K]$, and any $P_0 \in \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{G}}(a^*, \underline{\Delta}, \overline{\Delta})$, any consistent ... and asymptotically invariant ... strategy ... satisfies $\limsup_{T \to \infty} -\frac{1}{T}\log\mathbb{P}_{P_0}(\widehat{a}^\pi_T \neq a^*) \leq \frac{\overline{\Delta}^2}{2\left(\sigma^{a^*} + \sqrt{\sum_{a\in[K]\backslash\{a^*\}}\left(\sigma^a\right)^2}\right)^2}$.

results.notes: Uniform lower bound in terms of variances; the paper says the H-GNA-EBA strategy with correct hypothesised best arm attains it, but no formal upper-bound theorem is given.

symbols.G_star: max_{w in simplex} min_{a*, a != a*} 1/(2*Omega^{a*,a}(w))

conditions: strategy is consistent and asymptotically invariant (pi in Pi^cons ∩ Pi^inv)
worst case over P_0 in union over a* of P^G(a*, Delta_low, Delta_bar)

source.label: thm:semipara_bandit_lower_bound_lsmodel_asymp_inv_equiv
source.quote: For any $0 < \underline{\Delta} \leq \overline{\Delta} < \infty$, any consistent ... and asymptotically invariant ... strategy $\pi\in\Pi^{\mathrm{cons}}\cap \Pi^{\mathrm{inv}}$ satisfies $\inf_{P_0\in\cup_{a^*\in[K]}\mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{G}}(a^*, \underline{\Delta}, \overline{\Delta})}\limsup_{T \to \infty} -\frac{1}{T}\log \mathbb{P}_{P_0}( \widehat{a}^\pi_T \neq a^*(P_0))\leq \mathrm{LowerBound}(\overline{\Delta})$.

results.notes: Same expression as Theorem 4.1. For K=2 the paper notes the bound equals Delta_bar^2/(2(sigma_1+sigma_2)^2).
